title: Flight time
text: The drone shall fly at least 25 minutes with a 500 g payload

title: Return home
text: The drone shall return to its take-off point when the battery falls below 20 %

title: Geofence
text: The drone shall not leave a configured 2 km radius

title: Video link
text: The drone shall stream video to the operator with less than 200 ms latency
